correctness.rationale: Because q=2r+1 and 3r>2r+1 for r≥2, three pairwise disjoint r-faces are impossible, so the tupling complex is exactly a graph. Graph vertices are colored r-tuples and edges correspond to omitted color ℓ plus unordered complementary r-subsets of the other 2r colors, giving V and E. Johnson support graph is connected and every Johnson adjacency has a two-edge path via the complementary support, so odd Kneser support graph and its complete-bipartite fiber inflations are connected; integral cycle rank E−V+1 follows. A fixed colored tuple requires supports to be unions of entire color permutation cycles and one compatible fixed return element per cycle. Each fixed edge has an invariant omitted color: if endpoints are fixed separately, its used color cycles are allocated wholesale with hℓ/2 complementary partitions; if exchanged, each must alternate along even-length cycles with 2^{kℓ−1} assignments. Signed graph chain exact sequence gives χ=1−V_g+E_g^+−E_g^−, no missed orientation signs. Independently enumerated 40 vertices and 240 edges at r=2,a_i=2, and checked 31 distinct color permutations against exact signed action; in the nontrivial (0 1)(2 3) example (V_g,E_g^+,E_g^−)=(4,4,8), χ=−7. Read the source verifier tests 495 actions including r=3. Finite checks are corroboration only.
residual_risks: The allowed automorphism group is induced by size-preserving color permutations and bijections inside classes; not necessarily the full abstract graph automorphism group for degenerate sizes.
The factor hℓ/2 is an integer because complements pair equal-r subsets, while E_g^- only contributes for even cycles; r≥2 is necessary for graph dimension.

value.rationale: The graph D^r(X) is a natural near-threshold case of the recently introduced simplicial tupling operation. A complete all-part-size first-homology character for its natural colored symmetry group separates preserved and reversed edge contributions and can determine invariants of symmetry quotients; this is mathematically informative beyond a routine graph rank. The local combinatorial expression works for every automorphism in a large parameterized family.
residual_risks: Standard graph Euler characteristic alone is routine; value is in complete explicit return-cycle character and its orientation-sensitive fixed edge counting.

limitations: Only r≥2 and exactly 2r+1 nonempty classes; only induced size-preserving color and fiber automorphisms, not every abstract graph automorphism.
Determines rational characters and an integral free rank, not complete integral indecomposable representation lattice.
